scope: Atomic-only PK reselection on AdventureWorks, comparing the pre-patch sort key (len(cols), -id_score, -self_ref) without table-name lower-casing against the post-patch sort key (len(cols), is_uuid, -id_score, -self_ref) with table-name lower-casing.  Composite candidates are not reconstructed because per-composite features are not committed to disk.
